_comment: Bundled device catalog. 'devices': scan ident -> definition file, or a table by HW variant whose entry may be a profile {file, model} (the same device type behind a bus coupler reuses one file). The bus address is not part of it; it is stamped on at runtime. 'models': file -> appliance model. 'cdn': file -> upstream ebus.github.io paths carrying its display text. 'climate': per-zone registers of a heating zone. 'number_bounds': [min, max, step] of writable registers. All definition files are our own Apache-2.0 work (see PROVENANCE.md).

models._comment: Model shown in HA, keyed by definition file. For devices behind a bus coupler the scan ident is the coupler (both the heat pump and the eloBlock scan as 'V32'); this shows the actual appliance instead.

cdn._comment: Definition file -> upstream ebus.github.io source path(s) (without the /<lang>/ prefix and .csv suffix). Used at runtime, on the user's own machine, to fetch the per-language display text and generate local translation files -- the GPL-3.0 upstream text is never stored in this repo. eloblock/netx3 are our own definitions with no upstream source.

climate._comment: Per-zone registers of a heating zone. For each zone N, '<prefix>N<target>' is the writable setpoint of manual heating, '<prefix>N<current>' the room temperature, '<prefix>N<mode>' the operating mode, '<prefix>N<setpoint>' the setpoint in effect now (time program, setback, quick veto) and 'veto' the temporary override (setpoint, duration, and the special-function value that marks it); 'modes' names the mode values that mean off, automatic (time program) and manual heating. 'special' is the special-function register with its values for no special function ('none') and others (e.g. 'ventilation': heating off for 30 min, the app's Stosslueften), 'holiday' the away period (dates) and its own temperature, 'timer' the time program (slot counts per weekday, the first slot of Monday..Sunday), 'setback_mode' the register ({n} = zone number: zone N is served by circuit N) that says what applies outside the time slots, with its values for 'eco' (heating off) and 'normal' (setback temperature). VRC 720/3 manual 0020334315_04, ch. 2.9/2.14.1.

number_bounds._comment: [min, max, step] for number controls; float registers need them.
